summary: Updated miniupnpc package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
CVE-2026-110656 - miniupnpc through 2.3.3 contains a one-byte heap
out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the minixml parseelt function's
namespace-prefix handling that skips an end-of-buffer check after
advancing past ':'. A malicious or spoofed UPnP gateway on the local
network can send a device description or SOAP reply ending in ':' within
an element name to crash the client.
CVE-2026-110655 - miniupnpc through 2.3.3 contains a one-byte heap
out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the minixml parseatt function that
allows malicious UPnP gateways to read past buffer bounds via crafted
replies. Attackers on the local network can spoof a gateway serving
device descriptions or SOAP responses ending in '=' to crash the client.
